answer: Stop sybils with a voyage trellis: an agent stakes a bond for one voyage. Its trellis of checkpoints stamps the voyage. At each comet pass verifiers sweep it; a voyage with a copied or skipped stamp, or claimed twice, voids, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 voyages at 17x cost each: each stamp fits one voyage and one checkpoint, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents voyage once and keep rights.
